Investors are bracing for a heavy earnings week and the Fed decision Wednesday at 2 p.m. ET (CME FedWatch ~90.6% odds of no change; a 'hawkish pause' is possible after hotter inflation data). AI stocks have struggled to rebound after last week's selloff. Itau Unibanco is down ~28% premarket after Lula won Brazil's election.

items.headline: Ether near $2,320 as US spot ether ETFs are on pace for about $1.18B of October outflows; Glamsterdam test delayed
items.summary: Per Farside Investors data cited by Crypto Times, spot ether ETFs have had net inflows on only three of 17 October sessions, and BlackRock's ETHA accounts for most of the selling. Separately, core developers postponed the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet (set for Oct 26) to study EIP-8037; no mainnet date is set. Continued outflows and a delayed upgrade weigh on ETH sentiment ahead of Wednesday's Fed decision.

items.headline: Wall Street weighs SpaceX earnings and a likely Tesla tie-up; Canaccord lifts Tesla target to $442
items.summary: After SpaceX's better-than-expected quarter, strategists are treating a SpaceX-Tesla combination as likely, though no deal is announced (special committees formed; a SpaceX filing said no determination has been made). Canaccord raised its Tesla target to $442 from $410 on a merger scenario; Yorkville's Dan Ives sees an 80-90% chance of a deal by end-2027. Tesla closed Friday at $372.22 (-0.63%). Merger headlines are a swing factor for TSLA; deal terms and dilution are unknown.
